children: Chang Woei Jiann disclosed a 10.0% stake in Aterian, Inc. common stock. He completed the purchase on September 25, 2026, through a Securities Purchase Agreement signed on September 1, 2026, with former controlling shareholder David E. Lazar. The deal converted preferred shares into 26,121,180 common shares and coincided with the appointment of William H. Crampton to Aterian’s board.

Jiann bought 193,347 shares of Aterian’s Series AAA Preferred Stock in a private transaction and converted them into 26,121,180 common shares for $1,296,000. At closing, Aterian named William H. Crampton to the board to fill a vacancy created by the resignation of Avraham Ben‑Tzv.

Jiann may buy more Aterian shares in the future and could speak with the company about additional purchases. For now, he does not plan mergers, restructurings, asset sales, or other major changes at Aterian.

Chang Woei Jiann is a Malaysian investor who reports beneficial ownership as an individual. He focuses on direct stakes in public companies and uses negotiated deals like purchase agreements to build positions. He evaluates opportunities based on company fundamentals and may add to holdings over time.
